text_block_list.text:
After class, the previously clear skies
turn into
heavy rain.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh no, it's pouring.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: What?! No waaay!
text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday

text_block_list.text:
I was going to eat sooo many marvelous
sundaes
today!
text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday

text_block_list.text: Pffft. What the heck? That's so dum—
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Huh? Did I say something weird?
text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday

text_block_list.text:
Oops... N-no, it was nothing. Just ignore
us.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Oh, by the way, my trainer said there's
something
more exciting than sundaes!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Really?! What is it? Tell meee!
text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
choice_data_list: Uh... a game we can all play together?

text_block_list.text:
Games? I don't think we have any just
lying
arou—
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Oh. Hold on.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер gets some milk caps and
puts them
on the floor.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's an oldie, so I don't know if you'll like
it.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
What's thiiis? ☆ I've never seen anything
like
them! How marvelous! ★
text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday

text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, I suppose a whippersnapper
like you
wouldn't know about this game.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
It's called milk caps. See, you stack them
up and
slam them like this!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Whoa! They flipped!
text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday

text_block_list.text:
Just like that, you keep flipping the caps
on the
floor.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Super-duper marvelous! ☆ It'd be so
much fun to
play with everyone!
text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday

text_block_list.text: Everyone?! Wait! ...And she's gone.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, so this is the game you were
talking about!
These milk caps are so
cute! They look like
pins! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Hey! There's one with Carrot Ranger on
it too!
text_block_list.name: Бико Пегасус

text_block_list.text:
Well then. Now that everyone has a milk
cap,
shall we begin?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Yeahhh!
text_block_list.name: Everyone

text_block_list.text:
Under the guidance of Найс Нэйчер,
everyone has
fun playing milk caps.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The game is simple, but the surprising
amount of
strategy involved captivates
everyone.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Uuuggh... The stack is so small now! I
can't flip
any!
text_block_list.name: Бико Пегасус

text_block_list.text:
Heh, here's a pro tip. You can just aim at
the
stack like so, and...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! You're a pro, Nature! You flipped
all of
them!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I didn't expect this to turn into such a
big event...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But sometimes it's fun to get everyone
together.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Ummm, what? That sounds like a little
too much
for my ol' body, so I'll pa—
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: That's it!
text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday

text_block_list.text:
Let's go to the gym, you two! ☆ We can
invite
everyone and play tag there! ★
text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday

text_block_list.text:
W-wait, quit pulling me! I said I'm not
going!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: This is so fun! ☆ One more round! ★
text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday

text_block_list.text:
Waaaait! You seriously wanna keep
going?!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Of course! ♪ I'm nowhere neeear done!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I won't lose this time! I'll use my Pegasus
Mach
Strike so no one can catch me!
text_block_list.name: Бико Пегасус

text_block_list.text: Ughhh... How are none of you tired?!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: I'm glad I'm not the only one.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I have a suggestion. How 'bout we sneak
out of
this war zone?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: All righty, I'll leave you young'uns to it!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Heeey! Nature and her trainer are
running away!
text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday

text_block_list.text:
Oooh, they must be expanding the
game's
boundaries to cover the entire
academy! How
exciting! ☆
text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday

text_block_list.text: I'm gonna get you! ☆
text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday

text_block_list.text: Huh?! I didn't say that!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Get 'emmm!
text_block_list.name: Everyone

text_block_list.text: Oh, come ooon!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
They continue chasing us. Even though
we're
exhausted, it seems to be a good
workout for
Найс Нэйчер.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Milk caps is the biggest game on campus
for a
while after.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
